questions.q: What does the director reflect on at the beginning of the video?
o: People's need to leave traces and record life
questions.e: In the video: "Odakle dolazi ta naša potreba da nešto zabeležimo, dokumentujemo, da se sećamo?" — where does that need of ours come from, to record something, to document, to remember?

questions.q: What was the cinema of his childhood called?
questions.e: In the video: "bioskop... zvao se Lekino brdo, a mi smo ga zvali Buvara" — the cinema... was called Lekino brdo, and we called it Buvara.

questions.q: What did the projectionist do with the cut-off pieces of film?
questions.e: In the video: "kad je on sekao tu traku i lepio je... skupljao i delio je to deci" — when he cut that tape and glued it... he collected it and handed it out to the children.

questions.q: What camera did he want at 16–17?
questions.e: In the video: "ruska amaterska filmska kamera, 8 mm, marke Kvarc" — a Russian amateur film camera, 8 mm, of the Kvarc brand.

questions.q: How did he get this camera?
o: His mother bought it as a keepsake of the demolished house
He bought it with his own money
questions.e: In the video: "rušili kuću... majka je pitala... šta želimo da nam kupi kao uspomenu na tu kuću... ja sam kao iz puške rekao: rusku filmsku kameru" — they were demolishing the house... my mother asked... what we wanted her to buy us as a keepsake of that house... I said instantly: a Russian film camera.

questions.q: Where did he shoot his first footage?
questions.e: In the video: "prve svoje snimke napravio baš u ovom parku, Topčiderskom parku" — I made my first recordings in this very park, Topčider Park.

questions.q: What attracts the director to documentary film?
o: There is always an element of uncertainty and the unforeseen
questions.e: In the video: "koliko god da se vi pripremite za to snimanje, postoji neka doza neizvesnosti... uvek se desi nešto nepredviđeno" — however much you prepare for the shoot, there is some dose of uncertainty... something unforeseen always happens.

questions.q: With which of his films is he completely satisfied?
questions.e: In the video: "„Čuvari tišine“, na primer, film o kojem mogu da kažem da je jedini film sa kojim sam potpuno zadovoljan" — "Keepers of Silence", for example, a film about which I can say it's the only film I'm completely satisfied with.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ljudi su za sobom ostavljali *tragove* svog postojanja.
questions.e: Trag — a trace, a footprint.

questions.q: Kinooperater je sekao *traku* i lepio je.
questions.e: Traka — a tape, a film strip.

questions.q: Našao sam neki *objektiv*, verovatno od projektora.
questions.e: Objektiv — a lens.

questions.q: Ja sam tu u *izlogu* primetio jedan aparat.
questions.e: Izlog — a shop window.

questions.q: Veliku dozu *uverljivosti*.
questions.e: Uverljiv — convincing, plausible.

questions.q: Uvek se desi nešto *nepredviđeno*.
questions.e: Predvideti — to foresee; nepredviđen — unforeseen.

questions.q: Život *osuđenika* u nekoliko zatvora u Srbiji.
questions.e: Osuđenik — a convict.

questions.q: Sad mi se čini da je to sterilno, zato što je sve *ispeglano*.
questions.e: Ispeglati — to iron out; here "too smooth, calculated".

questions.q: Još od nastanka civilizacije ljudi su za sobom ___ tragove svog postojanja.
questions.e: The action was repeated through the ages — imperfective ostavljali. Ostavili is perfective (once).

questions.q: Stanovao sam na Lekinom ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na Lekinom brdu.

questions.q: Pokušavao sam da napravim nešto što će biti neki ___.
questions.e: Biti + nominative case: neki projektor.

questions.q: gde je danas knjižara, nekad je ___ prodavnica Cinefoto,
questions.e: The participle agrees with the subject: prodavnica is feminine singular, so bila.

questions.q: Majka je pitala sestru i ___ šta želimo.
questions.e: Pitati whom — accusative case: sestru i mene.

questions.q: Film je prikazan na brojnim ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative plural: na festivalima.

questions.q: i naravno, s tim je ___ da ide i projektor i tako dalje.
questions.e: The participle agrees with the subject: projektor is masculine singular, so morao.

questions.q: Snimali smo tri dana u nekoj ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u kolibi.
